idea-plugin.name: PQC Deprecation Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Dates every quantum-vulnerable algorithm in your code against the NIST IR 8547 clock: deprecated after 2030-12-31, disallowed after 2035-12-31.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → PQC Deprecation Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pqc-deprecation-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pqc-deprecation-lint

action.text: PQC Deprecation Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run PQC Deprecation Lint on the file in the editor
